name: io.github.dislop-ai/dislop
title: dislop
description: Cutting AI slop is real productivity. Editorial and artifact linter for docs, web UI & slides.

tools.name: dislop_check
tools.description: Run deterministic offline anti-slop rules on draft text (0 credits, no login required; read-only). Use first before dislop_review or dislop_deslop.

text.description: Draft text, Markdown, HTML/CSS/JSX, or SVG source to inspect

filename.description: Optional virtual filename hint (e.g. draft.md or page.html) for modality detection

modality.description: Explicit format override when filename is omitted

pack.description: Scenario rule pack ID or auto to route by modality and content

register.description: Optional writing register to calibrate style thresholds

verbose.description: Include full rule descriptions (default false for compact output)

tools.name: dislop_verify
tools.description: Verify a before/after revision pair for preserved numbers, qualifiers, keep terms, and register drift (0 credits, no login required; read-only).

before.description: Original source text prior to editing

after.description: Revised draft text to verify against the original

filename.description: Optional virtual filename hint for modality detection

modality.description: Explicit format override when filename is omitted

pack.description: Scenario rule pack ID or auto

register.description: Expected writing register to guard against tone drift

keep.description: Exact terms or identifiers that must appear unchanged in after

allowAdded.description: Allow new numbers or dates in after that were not in before (default false)

strict.description: Fail verification on anti-degradation or cadence warnings in addition to dropped facts

tools.name: dislop_rules
tools.description: List all built-in anti-slop rule packs or inspect a single ruleId with its deletion test and examples (0 credits, no login required).

ruleId.description: Omit to list all packs; pass a ruleId to get its explanation and examples

lang.description: Output language for rule explanations (defaults to en)

tools.name: dislop_review
tools.description: Diagnose AI slop with multi-model genre review and return anchored dislop.findings/1 edit/rewrite/ask guidance without rewriting the file (1 credit, sign-in required).

text.description: Draft text or markup to diagnose

filename.description: Optional virtual filename hint for modality detection

modality.description: Explicit format override when filename is omitted

pack.description: Scenario rule pack ID or auto

register.description: Expected writing register for genre-calibrated review

lang.description: Explanation language (defaults to detected draft language)

maxFindings.description: Maximum number of anchored findings to return (1-25)

voiceProfileId.description: Saved dislop.voice/1 profile ID to protect personal style bounds

tools.name: dislop_deslop
tools.description: Rewrite a draft with multi-model anti-slop editing plus automatic fact-ledger verification and repair (2 credits, sign-in required). Unlike dislop_review, returns cleaned text or patch edits.

text.description: Draft text or markup to rewrite cleanly

filename.description: Optional virtual filename hint for modality detection

modality.description: Explicit format override when filename is omitted

pack.description: Scenario rule pack ID or auto

register.description: Target writing register to preserve during rewrite

lang.description: Output prose language (defaults to detected draft language)

output.description: Return structured edits array or full rewritten text

voiceProfileId.description: Saved cloud dislop.voice/1 profile ID to match author cadence

voiceProfile.description: Inline dislop.voice/1 profile JSON object when not saved in cloud

tools.name: dislop_office
tools.description: Review or rewrite extracted .docx/.pptx XML text segments with number and qualifier guards, preserving layout without binary base64 transfer (2 cr review / 3 cr deslop, sign-in required).

mode.description: Choose review for diagnostics or deslop for rewritten segments

pack.description: Scenario rule pack ID (defaults to executive-deck or business-brief)

segments.description: Ordered list of extracted text segments from the Office file (up to 400 items)

id.description: Stable segment identifier used to write edits back to XML

kind.description: Optional role such as title, body, table-cell, or speaker-note

text.description: Plain text content of the Office segment

tools.name: dislop_visual_review
tools.description: Run multimodal VLM layout, typography, and aesthetic anti-slop review on a rendered deliverable and return structured layout/typography findings with fix guidance (2 credits, sign-in required). Provide exactly one of `imageBase64`, `url`, or `html`.

imageBase64.description: Mutually exclusive with url/html: Base64-encoded PNG, JPEG, or WebP screenshot to inspect

url.description: Mutually exclusive with imageBase64/html: public HTTPS webpage URL to render and inspect

html.description: Mutually exclusive with imageBase64/url: standalone HTML snippet to render headlessly and inspect

targetType.description: Deliverable format used to select visual anti-slop rubric (webpage, slide, poster, infographic, diagram, comic, or print)

lang.description: Output language for review notes and actionable fix guidance (zh or en)

protect.description: Up to 12 brand, layout, or copy constraints that review recommendations must preserve

tools.name: dislop_voice_extract
tools.description: Extract a reusable dislop.voice/1 statistical style card from 1-5 clean human writing samples and optionally save it to your account (2 credits, sign-in required).

samples.description: 1 to 5 clean human-written prose samples from the target author

lang.description: Primary language of the provided samples

save.description: Save extracted voice card to your cloud account

tools.name: dislop_voice_manage
tools.description: List, fetch, or permanently delete saved personal dislop.voice/1 cards in your account (0 credits, sign-in required).

action.description: Management operation to perform on saved voice cards

voiceId.description: Target voice profile ID (required for get and delete)

tools.name: dislop_account
tools.description: Inspect your active dislop plan, monthly remaining credits, and saved voice profile count (0 credits, sign-in required; read-only).
